label: unrun
scenario: Three candidates from the Reply Assist comparison: C1 template library pilot in ws-alpha, C2 drafting prototype, C3 ws-beta customer research. Constraints: drafts only (protected); pilot budget standard. The requester supplies, without a source, that C2 saves 20 minutes per agent per day. C2's value hypothesis is stated against C1's baseline; ws-beta templates need C3's findings. The ranking must keep unknown estimates unknown and record overrides by rule.

input_refs.title: requester estimate: C2 saves 20 min/agent/day (no source)

checks: The constraint check is recorded before any score and C2 is marked conditional on remaining draft-only.
The supplied 20-minute figure appears only as a note on an unknown value cell, never as an estimate.
Every ranking entry with an unknown input has score unknown and a non-empty missing list.
Overrides cite a dependency or constraint rule, never a score; C3 is raised because it fills unknowns others need.
Sensitivity shows whether the C1/C2 order flips on their unknown value cells and names what settles each.
